app_fee.value: CAD 135 non-refundable fee per application, paid by Visa or Mastercard credit card.
app_fee.quote: A $135 CAD non-refundable application fee is required to submit your application.

fee_waiver.value: The Faculty of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies does not waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is mandatory. GPS does not offer application fee waivers upon request.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; some programs ask for GRE scores, see the program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT taken on/after 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with no band below 4.5 (older tests: 90 with no section below 21). Home Edition not accepted for 2027-28.
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, only the 1-6 score scale* is considered: | Overall score of at least 4.5, with no individual band score below 4.5 | Total score of 90 with no section less than 21

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each band; One Skill Retake not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5, with at least 6.0 on each test band

english_waiver.value: Degrees from listed Indian institutions (e.g. all IITs, IISc, Anna, Jadavpur, NIT Calicut, Hyderabad) meet the requirement; others may use a medium-of-instruction letter if the program accepts it.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants with credentials from the following institutions will meet the English Language Requirement. | Indian Institute of Technology (All campuses) | If your institution or country is not listed here, we may accept a medium of instruction letter verifying that your institution or program was fully taught in English.

also.quote: Do all departments accept Medium of Instruction letters? | No. Some departments may still require a formal English language test.

notes: Duolingo 120 (no subscore below 100) and PTE 61 also accepted. Each application needs a separate fee.
